title: International Math & Physics Summer Camp (IMPSC)
text:
International Math & Physics Summer Camp (IMPSC)

The International Math & Physics Summer Camp (IMPSC) is an advanced academic program designed for highly motivated high school students interested in mathematics and physics.

The program is led by a professor of physics at the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar, one of the world’s leading engineering institutions.

Participants will explore advanced topics including:

Mathematics: Number Theory and Topology Physics: Classical Mechanics

The program is conducted as an intensive three-week online course, featuring lectures, problem-solving sessions, and guided academic discussions.

The application deadline for the 2026 program is May 25, and admission is highly selective due to the competitive applicant pool.

Website: www.imc-impea.org
